panels.title: Application Uptime
panels.description: Application uptime since last restart. Updates every refresh interval.

panels.title: HTTP Request Rate (RED) - Requests/sec
panels.description: Server request rate per second. Shows traffic volume by method and URI.

panels.title: HTTP Error Rate (RED) - % Failed Requests
panels.description: Percentage of failed requests (with exceptions). Target: < 1% (warning), < 5% (critical).

panels.title: HTTP Response Time (RED) - Avg/P50/P95/P99/Max
panels.description: Average, percentiles (P50, P95, P99), and maximum server response time to client. Shows latency from server perspective. P95 target: ≤400ms (SLO).

panels.title: 🔴 RED Method - HTTP Metrics (Rate, Errors, Duration)
Latency SLO (/decks) - P95 ≤400ms
panels.description: SLO: P95 latency for /decks endpoint. Target: ≤400ms. Current value shown in ms.

panels.title: Error Rate SLO - 5xx ≤0.5%
panels.description: SLO: Error rate (5xx). Target: ≤0.5%. Current value shown in %.

panels.title: Database SLO - P95 Query ≤50ms
panels.description: SLO: P95 database query time. Target: ≤50ms. Current value shown in ms. Note: Requires histogram metrics enabled in application.yml (management.metrics.distribution.percentiles-histogram[hikaricp.connections.usage]=true).

panels.title: Availability SLO - Uptime 99.9%
panels.description: SLO: Application availability. Target: ≥99.9% (30 days). Current instant value shown.

panels.title: HikariCP Pool Usage (USE)
panels.description: Percentage of total connections (active + idle) vs maximum pool size. Shows pool utilization. Warning at 70%, critical at 90%

panels.title: JVM Heap Usage (USE)
panels.description: JVM heap memory usage percentage. Note: Some heap regions (Eden/Survivor) may have max_bytes=-1 (unlimited) in G1 GC, which is normal.

panels.title: 📊 USE Method - Resource Metrics (Utilization, Saturation, Errors)
SQL Query Execution Time
panels.description: Average and maximum time for SQL query execution (connection usage time). Target: avg < 50ms, max < 100ms

panels.title: SQL Query Rate
panels.description: Number of SQL queries executed per second. Shows database load.

panels.title: Connection Acquisition Time
panels.description: Time to acquire connection from pool. High values indicate pool saturation.

panels.title: Connection Timeouts (5m)
panels.description: Connection acquisition timeouts in last 5 minutes. Indicates pool exhaustion.

panels.title: HikariCP Connection Timeouts
panels.description: Number of connection timeouts in the last 5 minutes. Should be 0.

panels.title: GC Pause Time (USE)
panels.description: Total GC pause time per second. High values indicate memory pressure.

panels.title: Cache Hit Rate (Spring Cache)
panels.description: Cache hit rate for Spring Cache (users, usersByEmail) over 5 minutes. Formula: hits / total * 100. Shows 0% if no cache activity or metrics not available.

panels.title: Cache Operations Rate (Spring Cache)
panels.description: Spring Cache metrics (users, usersByEmail). Shows gets (hit/miss), puts, and evictions per second.

panels.title: Cache Size
panels.description: Current size of Spring Cache (users, usersByEmail). Shows number of cached entries.

panels.title: Cache Hit Rate (Custom - pagination-count)
panels.description: Percentage of cache hits over 5 minutes. Higher is better. Target: >80%. Shows 0% if no cache activity or metrics not available.

panels.title: Cache Operations Rate (Custom - pagination-count)
panels.description: Cache operations per second by cache type over 5 minutes. Shows 0 if no activity in last 5 minutes. The cache is session-scoped and only active during pagination requests.

panels.title: Container CPU Usage (%)
panels.description: CPU usage percentage for all containers (grouped by service name to avoid duplicates when viewing 24h+). Shows max usage across container instances. Target: <70%

panels.title: Container Memory Usage (%)
panels.description: Memory usage percentage for all containers (grouped by service name to avoid duplicates when viewing 24h+). Shows max usage across container instances. Target: <80%

panels.title: Container Network I/O
panels.description: Network receive and transmit bytes per second for all containers (grouped by service name to avoid duplicates when viewing 24h+). Sums traffic across container instances.

panels.title: CPU Usage (%)
panels.description: Total CPU usage percentage. Calculated as 100 - idle time. Target: <70%

panels.title: Memory Usage (%)
panels.description: Memory usage percentage. Target: <80%

panels.title: Disk Usage (%)
panels.description: Disk usage percentage for root filesystem. Target: <85%

panels.title: Disk I/O (IOPS)
panels.description: Disk read and write operations per second (IOPS)

panels.title: Load Average
panels.description: System load average (1, 5, 15 minutes). Should be < number of CPU cores

panels.title: Network I/O
panels.description: Network receive and transmit bytes per second (excluding loopback)

panels.title: 🖥️ OS Metrics (Node Exporter) - CPU, Memory, Disk, Network
🔴 ERROR Logs
panels.description: Critical errors requiring immediate attention

panels.title: ⚠️ WARN Logs
panels.description: Warnings that may indicate potential issues

panels.title: 🔒 Audit Errors
panels.description: Audit log errors (ERROR/WARN level from audit logger). Critical for security monitoring.

panels.title: ℹ️ INFO Logs
panels.description: General information logs

panels.title: 📋 All Application Logs
panels.description: Complete application logs (all levels)

title: Memocards - Application Metrics (v6.0 - Best Practices 2025)
description: Professional dashboard following RED/USE methodologies and 2025 best practices. Organized into clear sections: HTTP metrics (RED), SLO compliance, Resource utilization (USE), SQL/Database, JVM, Cache, Container, OS metrics, and comprehensive Loki logs. Ready for Prometheus alerting.
